changes.comment: The default label renderer now renders `View`/`Text` directly instead of going through `HtmlComponents` (`Label`/`Span`), and `labelEnd` markup (help text, icons, optional adornments) is rendered inside the label container after the text rather than as a sibling of it. Adds a `textClassLabelEnd` label option, applied to the label text only when `labelEnd` markup is present, and the tailwind theme now gives the label `flex flex-row items-center` plus `mr-2` between the text and the adornment (without the row direction the label end would stack below the text)
